thread:
Alex: quick sync — putting prod deploy (v2026.03.17) into the 21:00 UTC window. I'm owner for the push. calling out final rollback/readiness checks, pls ack and add anything missing.

Maria: ack. timeline looks good for us. final checklist: CI-green, canary metrics stable for 15m, DB migration reviewed, ops rollback steps documented. who is monitoring? :eyes: 

Jon: I'll be on monitoring from 20:45–22:30 UTC. will watch p50/p95, error rate, API latencies, and k8s events. ping @Jon if you want immediate rollback.

CI-bot: CI pipeline: all stages passed on main@f3b2c9 (unit/integration/e2e). image pushed: registry.redwood/internal/api:v2026.03.17.

Lisa: migration note — offline column add (non-blocking). migration runs as job and is reversible: undo script exists but requires manual activity: `psql -h prod-db -c "ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS foo_temp;"` — we also created snapshot snap-2026-03-16-19 before migration. IMPORTANT: there is no automated schema downgrade in the deploy.

Alex: thanks. rollback criteria proposal: 1) error-rate > 1% sustained for 5m, 2) p95 increase > 300ms sustained for 5m, 3) failed canary health checks or >5% 5xxs in canary group. if any trigger, immediate rollback to previous deployment and pause rollouts.

Maria: add: if there is a DB migration problem (data corruption or job failures), we escalate to emergency rollback + DB restore from snapshot. that'll take longer and we should open a high-priority incident channel.

SRE-bot: Monitoring playbook:
- health probes: `curl -sS https://api.prod.redwood.com/health | jq .status`
- verify canary: `kubectl get pods -l roll=canary -o wide` + `kubectl logs --tail=200` for the new pods
- k8s rollout status: `kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n prod`
- if rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api -n prod` OR `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=2 -n prod` (confirm revision with `kubectl rollout history`)

Jon: I'll run those checks and post findings in-thread every 5 minutes during the canary. also will keep an eye on flamegraphs in APM.

Alex: who will hit the rollback command if criteria met? Maria or Jon? need a single operator to avoid double undos.

Maria: I'll own the rollback command. Jon will call + confirm metrics and then I'll execute.

Lisa: dev note: after rollback, we need to revert the config flags (feature_flag_new_routing=false). I pushed the flag to the configstore PR — rollback will need manual flip if rollout happened.

Alex: got it. final go/no-go? we still need one more ack from infra team about capacity for canary. @Infra (cc: Maria)

Maria: infra (off-thread) confirmed there's spare capacity in eu-west1 and us-east1 for canary.

Alex: OK moving to go in T-15 (20:45 UTC) for monitoring warmup, canary at 21:00 UTC. Maria to execute rollback if Jon flags. Everyone please be available on this thread. :rocket:

Jon: on it. I'll start posting checks at 20:45. 

CI-bot: deployment plan saved: ops/runbooks/deploys/v2026.03.17.json, link: https://docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/deploys/v2026.03.17

Alex: thanks team — closing handoff. if anything changes ping here immediately.
